en.title: Migrate a two-player EraserSanGuoSha match
en.body: The eraser-table profile imports the original client rules, cards and local Socket.IO connection. Both desktop clients can play to a server-confirmed winner and receive the next deal.

zh.title: 迁出《橡皮三国杀》的双人完整对局
zh.body: eraser-table 配置导入原版客户端规则、卡牌和本机 Socket.IO 连接。两位玩家可操作至服务端确认胜方，并接到下一局发牌。
